hero.kicker: Ceramic coating in Sterling Heights, MI
hero.title: Salt season is long. **Coat it once.**
hero.lede: A ceramic coating puts a hard, bonded layer between your paint and a Michigan winter of road salt and brine. Our 1, 3 and 5 year packages include paint correction and a written warranty, and the shop is about 15 minutes from central Sterling Heights.

local.title: Why Sterling Heights paint needs more than wax.
local.intro: Daily miles on salted mile roads, automatic washes in between, and summer sun in open parking lots. That combination dulls clear coat faster than most owners expect. A coating changes how all of it sticks.

points.title: Brine does not get a grip
points.body: Liquid de-icer on Van Dyke, Mound and M-59 dries into a film that works on bare clear coat all winter. On a coated panel it rinses off, because the salt is sitting on the coating and not on the paint.

points.title: Fewer trips through the tunnel
points.body: A coated car comes clean with a rinse and a gentle hand wash. That lets you skip the brush tunnels that put swirl marks into the finish in the first place.

points.title: For trucks you plan to keep
points.body: The Ram 1500 is built in Sterling Heights, and plenty of the trucks we coat from here were bought to keep. The 3 and 5 year packages are meant for exactly that owner.

points.title: Glass in the same visit
points.body: Coat the windshield and exterior glass at the same appointment and rain sheets off at highway speed. You notice it the first wet morning on the Van Dyke Freeway.

logistics.title: Coating happens at the shop. Getting there is easy.
body: Ceramic coating is done indoors at our Clinton Township shop, where the lighting, temperature and cure time are under our control. From Sterling Heights that is a straight run east on 14 Mile Road, about 7 miles from the middle of the city.

Plan on leaving the vehicle with us for at least a full day. Uber is covered for the drop-off and pickup, or ask about valet: we collect the vehicle from your home or work in Sterling Heights and bring it back coated.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Our shop, 33115 Louise Ave, Clinton Township

faq.q: Can you apply a ceramic coating at my home in Sterling Heights?
faq.a: No, and you would not want us to. A coating has to go on in a controlled space, out of the wind, dust and sun, and then cure before the vehicle goes back outside. We do that at the shop. If the drive is the obstacle, valet pickup brings the vehicle to us and back to you.

faq.q: How long will you have my vehicle?
faq.a: Plan on at least a full day, and longer when the paint needs more correction. The decontamination, paint correction and cure time are what take the hours. We give you an exact window when we quote your vehicle.

faq.q: How much does ceramic coating cost for a truck?
faq.a: Coating is quoted per vehicle, because size and paint condition decide the work. A full size truck has more surface than a sedan and often more correction to do first. Tell us what you drive and we will give you a real number, usually in the same conversation. [Request a free quote](#quote).

faq.q: Is a coating worth it on a leased vehicle?
faq.a: Often, yes. The Refresh, our 1 year package, is built for leased vehicles and cars you will trade in soon. It keeps the paint easy to wash and protected through the lease without paying for years you will not use.
